statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r is exactly the maximum, over all deletion choices D, of the longest common prefix length of s_D and t, where a deletion choice D is either no deletion (so s_D = s and len(s_D) = len(s)) or deletion of one index d with 0 <= d < len(s) (so len(s_D) = len(s) - 1, s_D[j] = s[j] for 0 <= j < d, and s_D[j] = s[j+1] for d <= j < len(s)-1). For a byte slice a, its longest common prefix with t is the largest L such that 0 <= L <= len(a), 0 <= L <= len(t), and a[j] = t[j] for every 0 <= j < L.
preconditions: len(s) >= 1, len(t) >= 1, len(s) <= 100000, len(t) <= 100000, and every byte of s and t is a lowercase English letter (97 <= byte <= 122).
